about: Wetaskiwin is a city in central Alberta south of Edmonton, in parkland farming country near Maskwacis and Highway 2A. The Reynolds-Alberta Museum’s aviation and transportation collections, a historic Main Street, and a role as an agricultural service centre define the community. About 13,000 people live in Wetaskiwin.
